unresolved.topic: CC BY-SA crops and color grading
unresolved.detail: Fifteen active images are CC BY-SA. Cropping to 9:16 and color grading create adapted material. Whether the adapted image alone (or the whole livestream) must be released under the same license, and how that interacts with a commercial TikTok broadcast, needs a lawyer’s review. Attribution alone is not sufficient if ShareAlike is triggered.
unresolved.affected: All active images with status NEEDS_REVIEW.

unresolved.detail: Mixkit’s Stock Music Free License permits public performance on “any web or social media platform” and prohibits “TV & Radio Broadcasts”. This project treats TikTok Live/OBS as a web/social platform. Confirm that classification for every distribution channel, including any simulcast or third-party broadcast.

Mixkit grants use of the “Music Items” but does not provide a separate composer/publisher/master split for each track. The license is the recorded permission; independent chain-of-title confirmation is not available in this repository.

The three active original tracks and two archived originals were synthesised by scripts/generate_music.py with no samples. The project owner should confirm that authorship/contractor ownership supports the CC0 dedication.
unresolved.affected: peaceful-prayer-01, piano-worship-01, morning-prayer-01, and two archived originals.

unresolved.detail: Twelve images from the original temple application remain in public/assets with no source or license record. They are not in the Christian rotation, but they are still served by the static server. Do not broadcast them; archive or replace after provenance review.
Documentation screenshots can depict CC BY-SA backgrounds and are not cleared for standalone redistribution. Upstream demo images have no provenance record. Keep them out of the broadcast asset path.

Copyright licenses do not grant model releases or church/venue permissions. Several photographs show identifiable people or religious interiors. Assess publicity, privacy and property rights separately before commercial advertising use.
unresolved.affected: Photographs with people or identifiable interiors, especially cathedral-01 and cathedral-02.
